name: shield guardian
desc: Shield Guardian is a CR 7 construct.

actions.name: bound
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is magically bound to an amulet. While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to travel to it, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

actions.name: regeneration
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains [[lookup @healing.formula activity=5cGvjZJIJVicjJ3d]] Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: spell storing
actions.desc: A spellcaster who wears the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s amulet can cause the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item Fist]] attacks.

actions.name: protection
actions.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
